verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's data lineage, documented as covering BigQuery, shows where data originates, how it transforms and where it moves. This only partly covers the lineage half of the story, and the pack has no evidence of audit logs showing who ran which queries. Missing for 10: audit logs of who ran what, column-level granularity of lineage, any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I get audit logs of who ran what and column-level lineage of where data came from

citations.quote: Data lineage in Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex Universal Catalog) lets you track where your data originates, how it transforms, and where it moves across systems such as BigQuery and Vertex AI.
It shows you where your data comes from (the origin), where it travels (the destinations), and all the changes or transformations that happen along the way.
